title: Progress on Consultation for Transporting Migrant Workers by Buses or Other Modes of Transport
what_it_is: Progress on Consultation for Transporting Migrant Workers by Buses or Other Modes of Transport

sections.label: Lorry accident fatality average halved
sections.summary: Average fatalities from road traffic accidents involving persons onboard lorries halved from around six per year in 2013-2017 to around three per year in 2018-2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The average number of fatalities from road traffic accidents involving persons onboard lorries has halved, from around six per year from 2013 to 2017, to around three per year from 2018 to 2022.

sections.label: Employers warn against ban
sections.summary: Over 20 industry associations said in a joint statement that a Government ban would stop many companies, especially SMEs, from continuing business.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In a joint statement issued yesterday by more than 20 industry associations, including the Singapore Contractors Association (SCAL), Association of Singapore Marine Industries (ASMI), Association of Process Industry (ASPRI) and the Singapore National Employers' Federation (SNEF), the employers stated that if the Government imposes a ban, many companies, especially small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), will not be able to continue operating their business.

sections.label: Surmised rationale for lorry rule
sections.summary: No records definitively confirm the original rationale, but contemporaneous reports suggest the likely intent was preventing lorries from providing commercial taxi-like services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We do not have records to definitively confirm what was the rationale back then.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: However, we surmise from contemporaneous reports that the likely intent was to prevent lorries from being used to provide commercial taxi-like services and this remains relevant today.

sections.label: Accidents after Adjournment Motion
sections.summary: A week after the Adjournment Motion, two more accidents involving lorries carrying workers injured another 37 workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I should add that the Senior Minister of State had shared the steps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But just a week after my Adjournment Motion, there were another two accidents involving lorries carrying these workers and another 37 workers were injured.

sections.label: Injury proportion on lorries
sections.summary: A statement by various agencies said that over the past five years the proportion of persons onboard lorries injured in traffic accidents averaged about 4%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, we have also said in our statement that was issued by the various agencies that, over the past five years, for instance, to put in context, the proportion of persons on board lorries who have suffered injuries from traffic accidents, on average, is about 4%.

sections.label: No meaningful timeline given
sections.summary: The Member's question on timeline was already answered, and due to challenges, practical constraints and difficulties, talking about a timeline is not meaningful.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's question about timeline, I think I have already answered that before.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There are challenges, practical constraints and difficulties and, therefore, it is really not meaningful to talk about a timeline.

sections.label: Interagency work group on measures
sections.summary: An interagency work group is working on this, will work with unions and NGOs, and prohibiting transport of equipment and passengers faces difficulties and operational constraints.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, we do have an interagency work group that is working on this and, indeed, we will work closely with the unions as well as take into account the feedback from the NGOs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As regard to further measures that we could put in place, for instance, the Member's suggestion about prohibiting the transport of equipment as well as passengers, there are actually difficulties and operational constraints for this, particularly for those, say, in the specialist trade.

sections.label: Group consulting representatives
sections.summary: This can be looked into, and the group working on this already consults many of these representatives.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is something that we can look into.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But let me say that the group that is working on this – the interagency – is not called a "work group", but there is a group that is working on this that already consults many of these representatives.
